name: Ero ★ Lab ~Jikken Suru to Doushitemo Eroi Kekka ni Shika Naranai Kenkyuubu~
original_name: えろ★らぼ ～実験するとどうしてもエロい結果にしかならない研究部～
source:
The heroine and the protagonist live at a school famous for specializing in research.
Due to a number of failed experiments and accidents, their bodies somehow end up overlapping!? Their feelings deepen as they repeat foolish experiments and have sex in various situations.

Eventually, there is no need for the two to have any incidents--
this is a love story where the heroine enjoys the strange fate of her life until her secret desire comes true.

[Translated from [url=https://dl.getchu.com/i/item1005388]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
女主角和主角生活在一所著名的研究型学校。
由于多次实验失败和事故，他们的身体不知为何重叠在一起！？随着两人不断进行愚蠢实验，并在各种情境下性交，感情逐渐加深。

最终，两人不再需要任何事故——
这是一个恋爱故事：女主角享受这种奇妙命运，直到秘密愿望实现。

[译自[url=https://dl.getchu.com/i/item1005388]Getchu[/url]]
